problem: The plan's classes_of has two branches only: in the state directory the matching classes of classes.toml, elsewhere S1's path_class or unclassified. The reference class (.reference/**, a globs class that is neither a state-directory class nor one of the seven product classes) falls through the elsewhere branch and answers unclassified, which is the class the design reserves for a product path that matches no [paths] glob, with the block message pointing at a [paths] line that would not help.
proposed_resolution: When write-scopes (H5) is built, either teach path_class to return reference for .reference/** paths matched relative to the project root, or have the elsewhere branch of paths.classes_of add the non-product, non-state glob classes of classes.toml beside path_class's answer. Nothing on the slice reads the class yet.

where: next/plugins/vsdd-factory/py/vsdd/hooks/liveness.py (the StoreBusy seam with the records fix round)
problem: The records fix round in flight changes lock_release to raise StoreBusy carrying the entries it did release, instead of returning quietly. The attribute those entries travel under is not agreed anywhere the builder could read; liveness.release reads store.StoreBusy.entries (a list of the released lock entries, dictionaries) and falls back to logging the busy alone if the carrier is named differently, in which case a partially released session's entries would be released without a lock.released line.
proposed_resolution: Agree the attribute name entries on the StoreBusy of lock_release in the records fix round, and have its test assert it; liveness.release and test_release_logs_a_busy_store already read that shape.
